result.description: Compact pen-input tablet for sketching, note-taking, and handwriting capture. Features a 10.1-inch matte active surface, battery-free stylus, 8192 pressure levels, and USB-C connectivity for laptop and desktop use. Includes palm rejection, customizable shortcut keys, and compatibility with common drawing and annotation software. Designed for creative and office workflows rather than storage or graphics expansion.
